test_name: System and Services Acquisition - SA-11 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Payments-Core-171
Primary NIST family: System and Services Acquisition (SA); evidence focus: SA-11.
Environment: AWS GovCloud. Network access uses PrivateLink; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: one noncritical test finding is fixed and verified but the formal closure note is pending. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
